mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 76 degrees with clear skies by Reddan Soccer Park. We are seeing an elevated air quality index of 51 today, so please take that into account.

In city news, the Public Works department is reminding us to check our mailboxes for winter damage. Also, the City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K through 12 students, with entries due by July 22nd.
We have a busy schedule today with Yoga at Insight Wellness and the free Concerts in the Park. Looking ahead, we have more live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding our weekly police report, on Sunday, July 13th, officers responded to a call where a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, which sounds wonderful. Culver's is open until 11 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
